def prevoteRespResult [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) (src : w64)
    (reject won lost : Bool) (peers : List w64) : NState :=
  have s1 :=
    { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := recordVote s.votes src !reject,
      outbox := s.outbox, stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log,
      logst := s.logst, prvals := s.prvals, prevote := s.prevote, gh := s.gh, rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci,
      isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq };
  if won = true then campaignState id s1 false peers else if lost = true then becomeFollower s1 s1.term (W64 0) else s1

theorem nstateWf_campaignState [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) (pre
    : Bool) (peers : List w64) (cl : List w8 := []) : NStateWf (campaignState id s pre peers cl)

def voteRespResult [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState) (src : w64)
    (reject won lost : Bool) (ms : List Msg) : NState :=
  have s1 :=
    { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := recordVote s.votes src !reject,
      outbox := s.outbox, stepfn := s.stepfn, ticking := s.ticking, progress := s.progress, log := s.log,
      logst := s.logst, prvals := s.prvals, prevote := s.prevote, gh := s.gh, rd := s.rd, lt := s.lt, pci := s.pci,
      isLearner := s.isLearner, sdr := s.sdr, cq := s.cq };
  if won = true then sendMsgs (becomeLeader id s1) ms else if lost = true then becomeFollower s1 s1.term (W64 0) else s1

theorem nstateWf_voteRespResult [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState)
    (src : w64) (reject won lost : Bool) (ms : List Msg) (Hsf : NStateWf s) : NStateWf
    (voteRespResult id s src reject won lost ms)

def pvoteRespResult (id : w64) (ps : PState) (src : w64) (reject won lost : Bool) (mt : GMap w64
    w64) (ms : List Msg) : PState :=
  have s1 :=
    { term := ps.term, vote := ps.vote, lead := ps.lead, role := ps.role, votes := recordVote ps.votes src !reject,
      outbox := ps.outbox, base := ps.base, log := ps.log, commit := ps.commit, matched := ps.matched, rd := ps.rd };
  if won = true then psendMsgs (pwinState id s1 mt) ([pselfAck id (pwinState id s1 mt)] ++ ms)
  else if lost = true then pbecomeFollower s1 s1.term (W64 0) else s1

theorem nstateWf_prevoteRespResult [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (id : w64) (s : NState)
    (src : w64) (reject won lost : Bool) (peers : List w64) (Hsf : NStateWf s) : NStateWf
    (prevoteRespResult id s src reject won lost peers)
